title: Senior MLOps / ML platform engineer
description: A 6-year MLOps/platform engineer (Kubernetes, MLflow, CI/CD, Python, AWS) evaluated against 8 postings: one strong ML-platform match with Kubeflow/feature-store gaps, one adjacent DevOps platform match, one AI-content-evangelist keyword trap name-dropping the whole stack, one marginal data-science role, and four distractors.
rationale: The resume is deliberately cross-domain — infrastructure operations (Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS, CI/CD) fused with ML tooling (MLflow, model serving) — so relevance judgments must weigh both halves. j3 is the constructed keyword trap: an AI content evangelist / growth marketing role that name-drops MLflow, Kubernetes, Kubeflow, and LLMOps buzzwords for audience-building content, but is a marketing job family with no engineering overlap, hence grade 0; TF-IDF will over-rank it on token overlap alone. j1 is the gap target: strong overlap on Python, Kubernetes, MLflow, AWS, Terraform, and CI/CD justifies grade 3, while required Kubeflow Pipelines and the Feast feature store are clear high-severity gaps, GPU workload scheduling is medium (his Kubernetes operations experience partially transfers but no GPU-specific work appears), and preferred Ray is low. j2 (pure DevOps platform engineer) matches the infrastructure half of the resume at grade 2. j4 (data scientist) shares real Python/ML-ecosystem overlap but sits in the modeling/statistics family, hence marginal grade 1; the remaining four jobs are graded 0.

resume.summary: Platform engineer with 6 years across infrastructure and ML systems, currently building the model training and serving platform for a computer-vision company. Owns the path from Terraform-provisioned AWS clusters to MLflow-tracked deployments, with CI/CD and observability treated as first-class features.

jobs.raw_text:
Senior ML Platform Engineer — Ardenware AI (Remote, US)

Ardenware AI builds document-intelligence models for insurers. Our ML platform team is hiring a Senior ML Platform Engineer to own training and serving infrastructure.

What you will do:
- Own the model training and serving platform on EKS, provisioned with Terraform
- Build and operate Kubeflow Pipelines for automated retraining and evaluation
- Stand up and run a Feast feature store shared across ML teams
- Manage GPU node pools and workload scheduling for distributed training
- Extend CI/CD pipelines for model packaging, canary rollout, and rollback

Requirements: Python, Kubernetes, MLflow, Kubeflow Pipelines, Feast. 5+ years in platform, DevOps, or ML infrastructure roles, with 2+ years operating ML workloads on Kubernetes. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience.

Nice to have: Ray, GCP Vertex AI, Istio.
